1.consolidated_definition: Coger de mingo. “Con el que tan mal nos trata -a los que en ésta nacimos, -que según acá decimos -nos ha tomado por chata.” José G. Padilla, . “Pero tú a cada paso te dejas insultar, y ya en el barrio te han cogío de chata.” González García, Cosas de antaño, 1922, 2 p. 182.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To be taken for a fool or to be considered foolish. "With the one who treats us so poorly - those of us born here - as we say around here - has taken us for a chata." José G. Padilla.

But you let yourself get insulted at every step, and in the neighborhood they have already taken you for a chata. González García, Cosas de antaño, 1922, 2 p. 182.
